notes: Use-case summary: real-time ad ranking + conversational bidding assistant. Mix of high-QPS short queries (reranking) and longer chat sessions for sales ops.
Latency targets: p50 < 20ms for embeddings/rerank path, p99 < 200ms for rerank; chat p50 < 80ms, p99 < 400ms during steady-state.
Throughput targets: baseline 5k tokens/sec sustained for reranking cluster, peak burst 12k tokens/sec for seasonal events; expect ~300-500 qps for short rerank requests.

Reserved GPU planning: POC recommends 4x H100 (80GB) + 8x A100 (80GB) baseline with autoscale headroom to 16 GPUs for peak. Preference for H100 for long-context chat (32k) and A100 for cost-sensitive reranking.

Model preferences: open models preferred. POC to validate 32k context length for "pegasus-chat-32k" variant; plan to test both int8 and 4-bit quant profiles. Want evaluation on bias/regression and latency/cost tradeoffs.

Quantization profiles discussed: "dynamic-4bit" (best perf), "static-8bit" (safer quality), and an experimental int8-kv for rerank path. SE advised q4_dyn + per-layer fallback for chat to guard quality.

Batching and KV cache: target batch size 64 for rerank path with continuous batching windows of 12ms; enable KV prefix caching for repeated session contexts. Warmup strategy: prepopulate KV from session store on handoff.

SLA negotiation points: 99.95% uptime, p99 tail latency credits, maintenance windows localized to low-traffic hours, guaranteed fallback to lighter model family on congestion, playbook for rolling upgrades and rollback tempo.

Data controls: need KMS integration and audit logging; retention controls for conversational logs (90 days) + ability to configure longer retention for sampled logs. Data residency: US-only for adtech compliance.
Security comments: "If Redwood can present SOC2 Type II + SAML SSO flow demo we can unblock procurement faster" (CTO paraphrase).

Next-step POC plan (short): 1) Dedicated cluster deploy in VPC with reserved GPU mix; 2) Run synthetic rerank workload + production trace replay for 14 days; 3) Evaluate p50/p99, tokens/sec, GPU utilization; 4) Tune quant profile and batching config; 5) Draft SLA and pricing for reserved contract.
Quoted risk: legal wants 'credits for p99 > threshold' and explicit maintenance notification SLA. Also concerned about on-prem/air-gapped feasibility for future compliance needs.
